notes.title: 🚀 KEBABSTAR EARLY ACCESS LAUNCH - July 19, 2025 @ 21.00 UTC! 🚀
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891883/0fd5addf340f4e11fc470fd091a6e645dd0627cc.png
KEBABSTAR EARLY ACCESS RELEASE DATE

UNIQUE STORY
Boran loses his prized camel in the desert, left with nothing but his last pair of glasses. As he collapses under the scorching sun, barely clinging to life, he puts them on—only to wake up in a strange, unfamiliar world.

Now, trapped in a reality he doesn’t recognize, Boran must rely on his kebab-making skills to survive. But this is no ordinary world… and he’s no ordinary chef.

Will he uncover the truth behind his sudden arrival and find the cult behind of the magic secrets? Or will he be lost forever between dimensions? 

REALIZED WITH THE AI
Behind the sizzling grills and chaotic kitchens of Kebabstar lies a deeper mystery—one woven by an ancient cult and powered by AI. As Boran navigates this strange new world, he’ll soon discover that his arrival was no accident.

A shadowy cult, obsessed with merging artificial intelligence and control the animals, has pulled him into their grand design. Their goal? To control reality itself—using the become the intelligence existence of all things.

REVOLUTIONARY HAND-CONTROLLED COOKING
Proprietary hand-physics combined with a deliberate dynamic camera angle creates unprecedented tactile feedback - every cooking motion feels tangibly real. Watch in awe as your hands move naturally - our inverse kinematics system translates your inputs into perfectly realistic cooking motions, down to each finger's position.

EXCUSITIVE REALISTIC GRAPHICS
Crafted with Unreal Engine 5.5's cutting-edge technology, every location bursts with stunning Nanite geometry, dynamic Lumen lighting, and hand-based chaotic cooking and shooting action game that'll make your magical destiny.

A MAGICAL EXPERIENCE FROM THE DESERTS

 The Luxury Part Of Arabia - Survive the scorching dunes, where you lost your everything.
 Dubai's Beaches - Grill kebabs under the hottest sands ever you can find in your every move.
 Istanbul's Grand Bazaar - Lose yourself in the maze of spice-scented alleys where the cult's influence runs deep.
 Kibris Island - Uncover the final piece of the puzzle where Mediterranean flavors meet digital conspiracy and secrets behind the truth.


🔔 Coming in Early Access July 19, 2025 - @21.00 UTC TIME 🔔
🔥🔥🔥WISHLIST NOW!🔥🔥🔥

notes.title: MEGA DEMO UPDATE - v0.1.5
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we are ready to release our new update about to improvements about gameplay, tutorial and mechanics regarding to our demo playtests.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891883/31056be237ca6814d478173c5220f226567fcd46.png

Frying Bug Fixed: The pesky frying bug that caused issues during cooking has been resolved. Your kebabs will now fry perfectly every time.

Upgraded Graphics: Visual improvements and better lighting make the game even more immersive. We upgraded our game engine to Unreal 5.4.4!

Enhanced Cooking Mechanics: Cutting, grilling, and serving have been fine-tuned for smoother gameplay.

Bug Fixes & Performance Enhancements: We’ve addressed other bugs and optimized performance for a better overall experience.

Quick Recap:

 Fixed the bug about frying.
 Tutorial videos have been sped up.
 Fixed an issue with the music volume during story transitions.
 Cutting is now more realistic, as there were occasional location shifts in the cut pieces.
 A progress bar has been added when pouring.
 The tutorial has been improved.
 An arrow has been added to the dial for better visibility in the tutorial.
 The "E" key now appears as a teaching indicator in the rotating plate tutorial.
 A "Confirm" button has been added next to the close button when reading letters.


Jump back in and experience the improvements in Kebabstar!

We love you all!

Don't forget to add Kebabstar on your wishlist!

notes.title: GRAND UPDATE DEMO - KEBABSTAR v0.1.0 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
Yes brother, Kebabstar v0.1.0 is now live, and we are extremely proud to share our first major update with you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891883/0812c307a57402ebe2f87a55e2390dba38412c2c.png

In this update, we focused on improving the tutorial, speeding up the game, and simplifying the Grand Bazaar section and easy way to go KIBRIS.

v0.1.0
EASIER TUTORIAL:

 We’ve added helper menus at the bottom, even if you don’t watch the tutorial videos.
 In the first section of the tutorial, you won’t need to press all the W, A, S, D keys.
 Added message now prompts you to place 3 tomatoes on the table.
 Press the F1 key to re-watch the tutorial videos.
 The flatbread (lavash) has been adjusted to the correct position.


DESERT ROSE ADJUSTMENTS:

 We’ve added arrows to guide players to check their followers and Sinstagram.
 Fixed the ketchup pouring mechanic.
 There was a bug where the döner wasn’t being cut because the plate was placed incorrectly; we’ve fixed this.
 Nobody noticed the Eyran, so we added an arrow pointing to it.


BEACH ADJUSTMENTS:

 The day/night cycle has been removed on this level.
 We noticed that many players weren’t talking to the ice cream seller at the beginning, so we’ve reduced the capacity of customers.


GRAND BAZAAR UPDATES:

 Atilla’s letters are now more visible. We added arrows, as many players didn’t realize the second or third letters were nearby.
 The secret letter and ticket to KIBRIS are now more noticeable.


GENERAL ADJUSTMENTS:

 The cutting of tomatoes, cucumbers, etc., is now more realistic and proportional.
 We’ve increased the amount of money earned from dishes to make it easier to finish the demo.


SETTINGS:

 We updated the graphics settings for screen resolution.


GAME MENU:

 We’ve added our Discord server to the menu, and we invite everyone to join.


Yes, bro our demo is now more stable and polished In the upcoming smaller updates, we will continue to make it even better in terms of gameplay.

We love you all so much, and we’re doing all of this for you, brother and we can't wait for defeat for Ice Cream Cult at KIBRIS!

DON'T FORGET TO ADD KEBABSTAR ON YOUR WISHLIST BRO!

Best regards,
-Zeybek Games

notes.title: GREAT PLAYABILITY UPDATE v0.0.5
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, We are happy to make the grand update for playability in our demo in v0.0.5!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891883/3583f6c468ebccaa9e54d4bab77ddf989e9b0301.png
We’re excited to announce our new patch helps you out the discover the story and the questline to play better and easier for the demo.

Here’s a quick overview of the updates:

 Better Take & Drop: Now you don't need to take items one by one on cutting board.
 Kibris letter and ticket more visible: After cutscene now we added indicators to show letters and tickets at the end of Grand Bazaar scene.
 Fixed Beach storyline complete: We just speeded up the beach storyline is more easy to complete. Ela, Ahmad Al-Yarram and Damla storyline more faster right now.
 Grand Bazaar Questline: We stopped the timer during the some notifications.
 Next Please: We understand that most of the players never choose "Get lost" option on the to take next customer. We changed this as "Next Please."
 More Faster Beach Storyline: Atilla's letters are now more visible.
 Several Bug Fixes: We fixed some crash bugs during.


We’re committed to fixing bugs and improving playability of the story in this update. Thank you for your continued support and feedback! 

Don't forget to add Kebabstar on your Wishlist!

Best regards,
-Zeybek

notes.title: DEMO IS NOW 3X EASY TO PLAY - Kebabstar v0.0.3 Hotfix
notes.content:
Hi Stars,

We’re excited to announce a new hotfix for Kebabstar Demo that makes finishing the demo faster!

Here’s a quick overview of the updates:

 Quest Helpers: We’ve added quest helpers to each quest to enhance your gameplay experience.
 Visibility Improvements: Atilla's letters are now more visible.
 Revolt Timing: You now only need 1 day to end the revolt in Grand Bazaar and initiate the counter-revolt.
 Guidance Enhancements: We’ve added arrow directions on the final letter and Atilla’s last Kibris Ticket in the Bazaar.
 Quest Notifications: Ahmad’s first phone quest now includes a notification.
 Magic Carpet Update: The view of our magic carpet has been improved.
 Bug Fixes: The issue with Kareem’s quest, if you’ve already spoken with Mehmet, has been resolved.
 Beach Level Adjustment: The Beach level is now faster, requiring you to complete only 3 or 5 kebabs to defeat Mehmet.
 Tutorial Change: Nazar’s second option in the tutorial has been removed.



We will put more effort into improving playability in future updates.

Thank you for playing Kebabstar!

Best,
-Zeybek

notes.title: [HOTFIX] Better Playability - Kebabstar Demo v0.0.2
notes.content:
Hi Stars, 

Here is the first small update of our fresh game. We will focus the playability in next of couple updates the complete Desert, Beach and Grand Bazaar scenes in our demo. 

Updates:
Tutorial Stage Recommendation: When you click the play button for the first time, the tutorial stage is now recommended. We've noticed many players skipped the tutorial, which impacted their gameplay experience.

Better Frying Potatoes: Frying potatoes has become more precise, giving you better control.

Improved Doner Kebabbing: Slicing doner kebab is now easier and more intuitive.

Quest and Recipe Display: The quest and recipe indicators are now located at the top right of the screen for better visibility.

Audio Options: We have added separate Music and Sound Effects options in the sound menu.

We focused to make this game better to will update the better playability and more easy to complete quests.

Keep following us, we love you!
